name: East Austin Athletic Club

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.note: Billed $215 every 4 weeks — 13 billing periods a year, not 12. 4-week minimum commitment for all new memberships.

plans.name: 2x / Week
plans.note: Billed $155 every 4 weeks. 8 large-group sessions per 4 weeks.

plans.name: Strike Club
plans.note: Billed $28.50/week (~$114 per 4 weeks). Unlimited striking classes and boxing-area open gym. One week's notice to cancel.

plans.name: Annual Paid in Full
plans.note: $2,449 paid upfront, which the club publishes as $189 per 4 weeks.

pricing_note: All memberships are billed every 4 weeks, so a year is 13 payments. Also offers a $75 week pass, a $30 single drop-in and a $275 10-pack. The $45 day pass includes one contrast-therapy session.
